snippet.title: Gravity Strikers | Demo Trailer - Wishlist Now
snippet.description:
Developed by ReSpark Entertainment, Gravity Strikers is a competitive FPS sports game. ⚽✨

In this fast-paced and dynamic arena sports FPS, teams compete in explosive 3v3 matches that mix strategy, speed, grappling hooks, and spectacular goals.

⚡Wishlist now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4268240/Gravity_Strikers
⚡Get Beta Trial on Discord for free:  https://discord.gg/yS9eyEmhry


🎵composer - Romain Daligault : https://soundcloud.com/ypsen/tracks
